events.title: Robo Nexus Founding Day
events.description: The official founding of Robo Nexus. A gathering of founding members to charter the club's mission, vision, and goals for the year.

events.title: Intro to Robotics Workshop
events.description: An introductory hands-on session covering the fundamentals of robotics — circuit design, motor control, and basic programming with Arduino.

events.title: Robo Soccer Tournament 2024
events.description: Our flagship in-house robotics competition. Teams built autonomous soccer bots and competed in a round-robin tournament on a custom-built arena.
highlights: First use of ESP32 + BTS7960 platform

events.title: Combat Robotics Showcase
events.description: A public showcase of combat robots built by club members. Students demonstrated their machines to peers, teachers, and parents.

events.title: Drone Flying & FPV Demo
events.description: AY Enterprise demonstrated custom-built FPV racing drones and fixed-wing aircraft from the Legacy Collection for students and faculty.

events.title: Season 2025 Kickoff
events.description: Kickoff meeting for the 2025 season. New members were inducted, project teams were formed, and season goals were set.

events.title: Robo Nexus Fleet Showcase 2025
events.description: A full-scale showcase of every robot and drone built during the 2025 season. The complete Robo Nexus Fleet v2025 was on display.

events.title: Advanced IoT & Automation Workshop
events.description: A deep-dive workshop on IoT systems, sensor integration, and automation pipelines. Members will build a smart environment monitor from scratch.

events.title: Robo Soccer Tournament 2025
events.description: The annual inter-team robo soccer championship returns. New V2 soccer bots will compete on an upgraded arena with live scoring.

events.title: Annual Robotics Exhibition 2025
events.description: The biggest event of the year — an open exhibition for all students, parents, and faculty. Every team presents their year-long projects.
